newsitem.title: USA: Edison nuclear station down for refueling.
newsitem.headline: Edison nuclear station down for refueling.

text.p: Edison International's Southern California Edison on Monday said its San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station Unit 2 was intentionally removed from service for a 70- day scheduled refueling and maintenance.
Edison is the operator and majority owner of the power plant, located in northern San Diego County.
The company said Unit 2 is scheduled to return to service in early February 1997. Meanwhile, Unit 3 will continue supplying electric power to southland customers.
